# Camera reference

Every setting of the top-down camera, with its default and range, and the calls for following, focusing and sharing the scroll wheel. For how to use it, see [Camera](../modules/camera.md).

## VtTopDownCamera

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Camera → VtTopDownCamera**.

Top-down follow camera with a fixed pitch, scroll-wheel zoom, edge scrolling and middle-mouse panning.

### Inspector fields

#### Target

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Initial Target (`initialTarget`) | `Transform` | None |  | Optional follow target assigned in the inspector. Assigned to the camera on Start if set. In a game, leave empty and call SetTarget() from your spawn code instead. |

#### Pitch & Height

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pitch (`pitch`) | `float` | 58 | 30 to 89 | Downward pitch of the camera in degrees. 58° gives a classic RTS feel. |
| Default Height (`defaultHeight`) | `float` | 12 |  | Starting camera height above the target on scene load, in world units. |
| Min Height (`minHeight`) | `float` | 6 |  | Minimum camera height — closest zoom-in. |
| Max Height (`maxHeight`) | `float` | 20 |  | Maximum camera height — furthest zoom-out. |

#### Zoom

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Enable Zoom (`enableZoom`) | `bool` | On |  | If disabled, the scroll wheel is completely ignored by the camera. |
| Zoom Speed (`zoomSpeed`) | `float` | 5 | ≥ 0 | World units of height change per scroll tick. |

#### Edge Scroll

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Enable Edge Scroll (`enableEdgeScroll`) | `bool` | On |  | If disabled, mousing near the window edge won't pan the camera. |
| Edge Scroll Speed (`edgeScrollSpeed`) | `float` | 20 | ≥ 0 | World units per second while the mouse sits in the screen-edge band. |
| Edge Scroll Border (`edgeScrollBorder`) | `int` | 20 | 0 to 200 | Screen-pixel distance from the window edge that triggers edge scroll. |

#### Middle-Mouse Pan

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Enable Middle Mouse Pan (`enableMiddleMousePan`) | `bool` | On |  | If disabled, holding the middle mouse button won't drag the camera. |
| Pan Speed (`panSpeed`) | `float` | 0.5 | ≥ 0 | World units panned per pixel of mouse movement. 0.5 matches typical RTS defaults. |

#### Input

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Snap Back Action (`snapBackAction`) | `InputActionReference` | None |  | Re-centres the camera on the target. Empty uses Camera Snap Back from the Vantage input actions, Space by default. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static bool IsScrollHeld { get; }` | True while the scroll wheel does not zoom: an owner holds it with `HoldScroll`, or `IsScrollBlocked` returns true. |
| `Transform Target { get; }` | The current follow target. Null if never assigned. |
| `bool IsInFreeCameraMode { get; }` | True while the camera is detached from its target (edge-scrolling or panning). |
| `static Func<bool> IsScrollBlocked` | External predicate — when non-null and returns true, scroll-wheel input is consumed by another system (e.g. rotating a building ghost) instead of zooming. |
| `static void HoldScroll(object owner)` | Take the scroll wheel away from zooming for `owner` until `ReleaseScroll`. Several owners can hold it at once; zoom returns when the last one lets go. |
| `static void ReleaseScroll(object owner)` | Let go of the hold `owner` took with `HoldScroll`. |
| `void SetTarget(Transform newTarget)` | Assign the transform to follow. Immediately snaps the camera onto the target and exits free-cam mode. |
| `void ResetZoom()` | Reset the zoom level to `defaultHeight`. |
| `void SnapToTarget()` | Re-center the camera on `Target` (exit free-camera mode). |
| `void FocusOn(Vector3 point)` | Look at `point` in free-camera mode, detached from the target. The snap back action returns to the target. |
